items:
Coastal Gains
Inlet Beach
S Wall St Inlet Beach, FL, 32461

Home Highlights:
~ 4 bedrooms
~ 4 bathrooms
~ Sleeps 14 guests
~ 2,200 sq. ft.
~ Gulf Front Beach Access right outside the front door
~ 4 Free Adult Bikes Included (Bikes not included Dec-Feb; additional rentals available upon request)
~ Open living area with ample seating and a stylish kitchen featuring granite countertops and stainless-steel appliances
~ First-floor bedroom with twin bed, private bath, and stand-alone shower
~ Second Floor Living, Kitchen and Dining as well as King Guest Bedroom
~ Master retreat on third floor floor with king bed, en suite bath (garden tub & stand-up shower), private balcony overlooking the gulf
~ Third floor bunk room (no door)
~ Fourth floor twin bed (Accessed by spiral staircase, no door on bedroom, personal air conditioner)
~ Outdoor seating areas to dine, relax and unwind
~ 3 Vehicle Driveway (Garage is for storage only)
~ Laundry room with full-size washer and dryer
~ Tv in all bedrooms except the fourth floor
~ Close to local attractions and dining options

Coastal Gains is a classic, Gulf-front beach home nestled on the quiet end of Wall Street in Inlet Beach, Florida. This well-loved retreat captures the spirit of Old Florida, offering laid-back comfort, stunning views, and direct access to the sugar-white sand—just steps from your door. Wake up to the sound of the surf and soak in sweeping, floor-to-ceiling Gulf views from the main living area, the gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances, and the spacious master bedroom. Step outside for coffee on the deck or head straight down to the sand—it's that close. With room for everyone, the home features three king bedrooms, a cozy twin room, a fourth-floor twin nook, and a custom bunk room with queen-over-queen and twin-over-twin bunks—perfect for families or group getaways.

Tucked into a quiet, scenic stretch of 30A, Inlet Beach still holds onto that laid back coastal vibe, while being just minutes from the shops and restaurants of 30Avenue and Rosemary Beach. Whether you're watching dolphins from the living room, enjoying a sunset dinner on the deck, or falling asleep to the rhythm of the waves, Coastal Gains brings you front and center to the magic of the Gulf.

Parking
Coastal Gains has designated parking for 3 vehicles in the driveway as the garage is for storage only. Street parking is not allowed. You may only have as many vehicles or golf carts as you can fit in the driveway.

Community Amenities
No matter where you come from, a visit to Inlet Beach will have you feeling like a “local” in no time. Take a walk down to the largest public beach access point in South Walton or spend the morning fishing from the Gulf of Mexico. Enjoy many new dining and shopping options in Inlet Beach. Or take a quick bike ride to the neighboring communities of Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach and Alys Beach to hit the shops or grab a bite to eat at any one of the area's popular eateries. Here, it's easy to make yourself at home, even on vacation.

Reservation/Booking Policy
***The cancellation policy and terms of the 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement emailed to you at confirmation override any terms and policies from a third-party booking site such as VRBO, HomeAway, Airbnb, etc. We are not able to reimburse any additional service fees incurred for online bookings outside of our company website since these fees are charged by a third party. We do not offer 100% refund for cancellation at any time after the booking has been processed. A 5% cancellation fee will be charged to cover credit card and document processing for all cancellations.

~ NO SMOKING
~ Pets Not Allowed (Excluding certified service animals only. If you are bringing a service animal, we ask that you notify us in advance and provide proper documentation so we may coordinate appropriate housekeeping after your departure)
~ PUBLISHED RATES DO NOT INCLUDE TAX AND FEES
~ 50% of the total cost is due at the time of booking
~ Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the scheduled arrival date (Or in full at booking if arriving within 60 days)
~ Except for a 5% cancellation fee, the initial 50% payment is fully refundable if cancellations are given more than 60 days prior to the arrival date
~ Optional travel insurance plans are available to our guests; some restrictions and timelines apply. Ask for details when booking. Insurance must be purchased BEFORE the final payment or at the time the reservation is paid in full.
~ CHECK-IN BEGINS AT 4:00 P.M. (CST) & CHECK-OUT IS BY 10:00 A.M.
~ Tenant must be at least twenty-five (25) years of age and will be an occupant of the Premises during the entire Rental Period. Reservations shall not be made by or for any person under the age of twenty-five (25), and no key will be issued to anyone who is not twenty-five (25) years of age. (Please see contract at the time of booking for further information)
~ Home is currently listed for sale
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located in Inlet Beach, a neighborhood in Panama City Beach, this vacation home is near theme parks and on the beach. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, while Frank Brown Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark are popular area attractions. Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting. Be sure to check out the area's animals with activities such as game walks and birdwatching.

reviews.author: Brian G.
reviews.label: Excellent

responses.response: Brian, we are delighted to hear you enjoyed your stay with us at Coastal Gains. This beach front home is just the way you described it. We hope you consider us for any of your future stays. Until next time!

reviews.text: We had an amazing stay at this beautiful beachfront home. The location truly couldn’t be better—just steps from the sand with stunning ocean views right from the house. Waking up to the sound of the waves and enjoying coffee on the deck each morning was one of the highlights of our trip.The house itself was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The wi-fi was spotty and seemed to be buffering a lot.

reviews.author: Gangajal K.
reviews.label: Excellent

responses.response:
Thank you so much for your thoughtful and detailed feedback! We’re really happy to hear that you loved the home, the location, parking, and the beach bikes—and we truly appreciate the recommendation.

We also appreciate you sharing your notes about the Wi-Fi and toiletries. We’re sorry for the inconvenience you experienced with the internet, and we’ll be reviewing this with our provider to improve reliability for future guests. Your feedback regarding toiletries is noted as well and helps us continue improving the guest experience.

We’re glad to know you still had a great stay overall, and we’d absolutely love to welcome you back again in the future. Thanks again for choosing to stay with us! 😊

reviews.text: The place is beautiful and location is excellent. I believe having toiletries and a better Wi-Fi would have been even better. We struggled with WiFi and there were no toiletries but otherwise no issues.The parking space, beach bikes and location all are amazing. Would 100% recommend it and try to come back again to stay.

reviews.author: Brooklyn C.
reviews.label: Good

responses.response:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re thrilled to hear you had an amazing week at Coastal Gains and enjoyed the incredible location and sunsets — there really is nothing like it. It’s great to know the bikes and nearby dining options helped make your stay so memorable.

We also appreciate your feedback regarding the house and internet. Your comments help us identify areas where we can improve for future guests.

Thank you again for choosing to stay with us, and we would love to welcome you back for another beach getaway soon!

reviews.text: We had an amazing week staying at Coastal Gains. The location is absolutely amazing! Nothing beats the sunsets at this beach and you are steps away from the home once the sun sets. We loved that bikes came with the house and the ability to easily rent more. We rode bikes everyday and found so many lovely places to eat within biking distance. The house is a little dated and the internet connection was not very good. But the amazing location outweighed the cons.

reviews.author: Liana L.
reviews.label: Excellent

responses.response:
Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a detailed review! We’re thrilled to hear that the home’s layout worked perfectly for your family and that you were able to enjoy the extras like the paddleboard, boogie boards, and beach toys. It sounds like you made the most of the beautiful 30A area, and we’re so glad you had a relaxing time.

We also appreciate your helpful feedback regarding the deck door, ice maker, TVs, and supplies. We’ve addressed all of these maintenance items and have corrected them to ensure an even smoother experience for future guests.

It was a pleasure hosting you, and we would love to welcome your family back anytime!

reviews.text: We love the beach and visit 30A several times a year, usually staying in a different beachfront home for variety. This particular house seemed to be a new listing and showed great potential. We’re a family of five, and our teenage daughter sometimes brings a friend—this was one of those times. The layout of the home was perfect for our group, with plenty of bedrooms and bathrooms to comfortably accommodate everyone. We also appreciated the extras like the paddleboard, boogie boards, and beach toys. For umbrellas and beach chairs, we used Coastal Beach Services, conveniently located right next to the house. Just a heads-up: while you can reserve online, they won’t set anything up until you show up in person at 8:00 a.m. Once you check in, they’ll handle the setup for you. As mentioned, the home is likely a new listing and still settling in. We had a minor issue with the main floor deck door, but management responded quickly and had it fixed within the hour. Just a heads-up for future guests: the listing didn’t include beach towels, and we couldn’t find dishwasher detergent or body wash. The ice maker wasn’t working during our stay, and only one TV had fully functioning remotes. We didn’t reach out to management about these things since they felt minor to us, but now that they’re aware, we’re confident they’ll take care of them for future guests. Overall, we had a wonderful, relaxing time and would definitely consider booking this house again.
themes: Liked: Cleanliness, check-in, communication, location, listing accuracy

reviews.author: Carol M.
reviews.label: Good

responses.response:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the beautiful location right on the beach — it truly is one of the highlights of the home!

We also appreciate your comments regarding the amenities. When you reported the internet issue during your stay, our team addressed it immediately, and the connection was restored at that time. The other items you mentioned, including the lamp shade, front porch light, and kitchen faucet water pressure, were not reported during your stay, but we’ve since had our maintenance team address and correct all of these issues.

Regarding the master bedroom TV, this required assistance from Mediacom, and unfortunately the repair could not be completed during your stay, but it has now been fully resolved.

We value your input and are always working to ensure our homes are well-maintained for future guests. We hope to welcome you back to enjoy the beautiful beachfront location again!

reviews.text: Beautiful home right on the beach. Several amenities did not work such as master bedroom tv and living room tv because internet kept dropping. Although management sent someone to look at this, problem remained. House needs to be maintained better. broken lamp shade, front porch light didnt work and kitchen faucet water pressure. The best was the location of the home directly on the beach.
